17/S0.subgoal: Describe the components and primary functions of IMU sensors in tracking.

17/S1.subgoal: Explain the calibration process for mapping cheap sensor readings to accurate values using linear least squares.

17/S2.subgoal: Describe how the system establishes an initial orientation and subsequently integrates sensor data to track it over time.

17/S3.subgoal: Describe how the drift correction stage combines multiple sensor values using a gain parameter to correct orientation errors.

17/S4.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
